cohort: The participants were all women who had a singleton vaginal birth during the period 1989 to 2006 at Aarhus University Hospital, Denmark.
finding: Maternal age 20-30 years and >=30 years, occipitoposterior fetal position, induction/augmentation of labour, and suspected macrosomia were independent significant predictors of OASIS, with increasing parity conferring a significant protective effect.
